name: kitchen cleaner spray Foam Cleaning Spray 500ml Easy Cleaning
description:
Kitchen Cleaner Spray – 500ml Foam Cleaning Spray

Make your kitchen sparkle effortlessly with this easy-to-use foam cleaning spray. Designed for all kinds of kitchen tools, it removes grease, stains, and grime with minimal effort.

Key Features

All-Purpose Kitchen Cleaner: Works effectively on utensils, cookware, stovetops, sinks, and other kitchen surfaces.

Hassle-Free Cleaning: Simply spray and rinse—no scrubbing required.

Powerful Grease Removal: Penetrates stubborn grease and stains for a spotless finish.

Foam Formulation: Water-based cleaner transforms into foam for even coverage and effective cleaning.

Safe & Convenient: Gentle on surfaces while tough on dirt.

Specifications
